rca of the issue: FirstUseTooltips not rendering: most likely the gate condition on the dashboard layout checks state.user.tooltips_seen reactively but the user object cached in client state right after onboarding may already have tooltips_seen flipped to true (or onboarded check is being used as the gate instead). Recommend inspecting where FirstUseTooltips is mounted in App.js / Garage.js — confirm the prop/state condition is `!user.tooltips_seen && user.onboarded`. share-copy-btn missing testid: VehicleProfile ShareMenu's copy button likely has a testid like 'share-copy-link' or 'copy-share-url' — needs renaming to 'share-copy-btn' per spec. FAB sub-actions: the Speed Dial / floating menu likely renders inside a portal or transitions in via Framer Motion — need explicit data-testids on each child action button.
